description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeLanguageAPI class, which provides RESTful endpoints for managing employee languages and fluencies within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for CRUD operations and applies validation rules and annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguageAPI
classes.description: Class providing API endpoints for managing Employee Language data, including CRUD operations and validation rules, within OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee language record based on employee number, language ID, and fluency ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all language records for a specific employee, supporting filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new employee language record after validating input and checking for duplicates.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing employee language record identified by employee number, language ID, and fluency ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or multiple employee language records specified by their language and fluency IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getOne endpoint.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing employee languages.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a new employee language record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating an employee language record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for deleting employee language records.
